correction_patch: P2.1 CONTENT PRODUCT HARDENING (four review findings; no P2 redesign)
schema_change_in_p2_1: NONE -- the new eligibility field and the restructured monster provenance are additive inside the existing /1 schemas

methods.get_monster: get_monster(monster_id, *, locale=None, level=None, formation=None) -> monster_product | None

removed_in_p2_1.skill_capability_lookup: REMOVED. It could supply capabilities but never the authoritative M14 execution-eligibility result, so retaining it would have created a path where M14-linked skills silently reported null eligibility, and it was a way to bypass M14 policy authority. The M14 dependency is now exactly one explicit, version-checked registry.

execution_eligibility_source.outcome_vocabulary: the canonical M14 machine vocabulary (ExecutionEligibilityOutcome), observed as exactly {"NOT_ELIGIBLE"}
execution_eligibility_source.inferred_from: NOTHING -- the field must not be derived from execution_readiness, support_status, binding_level or settlement_present; a test asserts none of those four names appears in the eligibility record
execution_eligibility_source.M14_REGISTRY_NOT_SUPPLIED: m14_execution_eligibility is null for every skill
execution_eligibility_source.unknown_block_field: unknown.skills_without_execution_eligibility lists every skill left without an eligibility record
execution_eligibility_source.previously_untrue_claim_now_true: the pre-P2.1 control artifact (and the module docstring) said M14 'execution eligibility' was copied verbatim while the separate authoritative result was in fact omitted; the field now exists

version_coherence_policy.registry_vs_database: ContentProductService.__init__ requires registry.content_version == database.game_version; a mismatch raises ContentProductError at construction (fail closed)
version_coherence_policy.capability_vs_service: every capability returned for an avatar is re-checked at call time; capability.key.content_version must equal service.game_version or ContentProductError is raised
version_coherence_policy.mixed_version_behaviour: REJECTED -- never silently dropped, never rewritten, never fallen back
version_coherence_policy.test_seams: the removed skill_capability_lookup was the only injection seam; no remaining seam can bypass the M14 policy authority

structure.provenance.sources: ordered list of {role, entity_id, original_game_id, game_id_status, confidence, reconstruction_status, entity_sha256, provenance, provenance_count}
structure.provenance.field_sources: a sorted map naming the source of every parent-backed field
structure.provenance.entity_provenance_count: sum of the per-source provenance counts

variant_parent_provenance.monster_variant_with_proven_parent: two sources, role REQUESTED_ENTITY (the variant) and role CANONICAL_PARENT, each carrying its own verbatim provenance and its own entity_sha256

parent_backed_fields.static_stats: CANONICAL_PARENT (a variant record carries only modify ratios, never base stats)

variant_parent_provenance.unproven_parent: identity.parent_resolved=false, only the REQUESTED_ENTITY source is retained, parent_provenance_available=false, and nothing is fabricated

enumeration_authority.facade_internals: a private _entity_ids(table) guarded by ContentDatabase.ENUMERABLE_ENTITY_TABLES == ("avatars", "monsters"); an unexpected table raises ContentDatabaseError
enumeration_authority.no_generic_api: ContentDatabase.list_entity_ids is deliberately NOT exposed, so the SQLite table vocabulary stays inside the facade
properties: canonical entity IDs only, never rows or columns
enumeration_authority.product_layer: ContentProductService now calls only database.list_avatar_ids()/list_monster_ids(); the product module contains no sqlite3 import, no database_path access, no SQL keyword and no storage table name, and it re-sorts defensively so its own ordering guarantee never depends on the facade
enumeration_authority.p3_note: stage/encounter enumeration can follow the same pattern with list_stage_ids()/list_encounter_ids()

monster_fields.static_stats_basis: SELF for a canonical Monster; CANONICAL_PARENT for a variant
monster_fields.static_stats_source_monster_id: the monster the stats were read from
provenance: sources[{role, entity_id, original_game_id, game_id_status, confidence, reconstruction_status, entity_sha256, provenance, provenance_count}]

locale_policy.observed_from: the collection block of every 4.4.54 avatar and monster record (97 + 628 records scanned)
locale_policy.requested_locale_none: returns every available locale under display.names and sets locale_status=MULTI; localized_name stays null
locale_policy.requested_locale_present: display.localized_name is that locale's value and locale_status=PRESENT
locale_policy.requested_locale_absent_for_this_entity: locale_status=ABSENT and localized_name=null; NO substitution and NO fallback (locale_fallback_used is always false)

enumeration_semantics.audit_item_closed: F8 (relevant part: character and monster enumeration)
enumeration_semantics.list_characters: 97 rows; per-row {schema, game_version, avatar_id, names, localized_name, locale, locale_status, rarity, rarity_code, path, element}
enumeration_semantics.list_monsters: 628 rows; per-row {schema, game_version, monster_id, names, localized_name, locale, locale_status, rank, monster_camp_id, weaknesses, variant_count, declared_child_count}
enumeration_semantics.ordering: deterministic numeric-aware ascending by avatar_id / monster_id (1, 2, ... 10, not lexicographic)
enumeration_semantics.explicit_content_version: fixed at construction by the explicitly versioned ContentDatabase; summary rows echo game_version
enumeration_semantics.latest_fallback: NONE -- the service exposes no version/content_version parameter at all

m14_dependency_path.how_supplied: the caller passes an explicitly loaded ContentSupportRegistry (load_registry('4.4.54')); it is version-checked against the database
m14_dependency_path.import_style: function-local (lazy), reached only when a registry is supplied; keeps the static module-level import graph free of a game_data -> content_support edge
policy_copied_verbatim: execution eligibility (outcome, reason_code, reason_detail, evidence modes, gate/native flags)
m14_dependency_path.no_registry_supplied_behaviour: capability.registry_loaded=false, capability.status=M14_REGISTRY_NOT_SUPPLIED, capability.skills_with_m14_row=null and skills_without_m14_row=null (explicitly unknown, never reported as zero), capability.skills_with_execution_eligibility=null, every skills[].m14_execution_eligibility=null, and unknown.static_skills_without_m14_row=null

character.unknown.unavailable_sections: lists any section that could not be produced (m14_capability / relic_reference / compatible_lightcone_ids / traces / eidolons)
character.static_skills_without_m14_row: explicit id list, or null when no M14 authority was supplied
character.skills_without_execution_eligibility: explicit id list of every skill left without an authoritative eligibility record
character.missing_locales: explicit list of vocabulary locales absent for this entity

monster.unknown.missing_static_stats: explicit list of the ten static stat fields absent from the record
monster.parent_unproven: identity.parent_resolved=false and only the REQUESTED_ENTITY provenance source is retained (never guessed)
monster.context_level: null with level_source=NOT_SUPPLIED rather than a fabricated default

determinism_policy.hash: every document carries product_sha256 = stable_hash(document without the hash field), using the repository stable_hash (json.dumps sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))
determinism_policy.ordering: all collections are explicitly sorted (numeric-aware for game IDs, lexicographic for locale/field keys); never dependent on dict iteration order

immutability_copy_policy.representation: plain dict documents carrying a stable schema string and a stable product_sha256
immutability_copy_policy.rationale: the game_data product layer already emits dict documents (stage_package/1, scenario_package/2), so dicts keep the layer uniform; a frozen wrapper over deeply nested payloads would either not be deeply immutable or would break json-based stable_hash and list/dict equality. P1's ambiguity is not repeated: no immutability is claimed here.
immutability_copy_policy.copy_isolation: every returned document and summary row is deepcopy-isolated, so a caller mutation cannot reach the database facade, another document or a later call
immutability_copy_policy.future_work: a frozen product type remains available as later hardening

characters.1105: Natasha -- 4-star, Priest, Physical, 6 skills all linked to M14, 50 trace rows, 6 eidolons, 3 compatible lightcones, no memosprite
characters.1409: Hyacine -- 5-star, Memory, Wind, 62 trace rows, 2 compatible lightcones, memosprite present (the materially different profile)
characters.1508: Rin Tohsaka -- 5-star, Mage, Quantum, 8 static skills with ZERO M14 rows (proves explicit missing capability and null eligibility)

monsters.1002020: Vagrant -- canonical Monster (A), single SELF provenance, weaknesses + damage-type resistance (D), two static skill references (E)
monsters.100202001: the P0 variant-only ID (B); requested id preserved, canonical parent 1002020, TWO provenance sources retained
monsters.determinism: same input -> same product_sha256, and a different level changes the hash (H)

test_fixtures.fakes: a fake M14 registry and fake SkillRecord-shaped capabilities carry chosen content versions so mixed-version behaviour is provable without a second content build
test_fixtures.offline: the packaged minimal fixture drives a robustness tier that proves missing sections/locales/stats degrade to explicit 'unavailable' rather than crashing; it is not a faithful real-payload sample (its field names differ), which is why the real acceptance fixtures use the local 4.4.54 database.

counts.note: This is a product census, not execution coverage. 627 of the 2,648 monster_variants rows are canonical-Monster self-variant rows (their id also exists in monsters), which is why they resolve as MONSTER; the 2,021 MONSTER_VARIANT rows are exactly the ones that now carry proven canonical-parent provenance.
